Rates.title: BoJ: April hike expected after soft data – Danske Bank
Rates.summary: Danske Research Team notes softer Japanese data, with composite PMI slipping and core CPI falling below target for the first time in four years, largely due to fuel subsidies. Despite this, PMIs show rising input prices and a weak Japanese Yen.

Rates.title: Fed: War fog clouds rate path – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY strategist John Velis says the March FOMC broadly matched expectations, with no rate change and minimal forward guidance, while markets swiftly repriced toward a more hawkish path.

FX.title: UK flash Composite PMI arrives lower at 51.0 in March vs. 53.7 prior
FX.summary: United Kingdom (UK) S&P Global Composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) falls sharply to 51.0 vs. 53.7 in February, according to flash estimates, due to a slowdown in both manufacturing and the services sector activity.

FX.title: Eurozone flash Composite PMI drops to 50.5 in March vs. 51.9 prior
FX.summary: Eurozone's preliminary HCOB Composite PMI arrives lower at 50.5 in March against estimates of 51.1 and 51.9 in February. The growth in the overall private sector business activity slows down due to weakness in the services sector.

FX.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Falls toward 111.00 near lower ascending channel boundary
FX.summary: AUD/JPY extends its losses for the second successive session, trading around 111.00 during the early European hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart suggests a potential bearish reversal as the currency cross is testing the lower boundary

Commodities.title: JPY: Disinflation tempers energy shock – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank analyst Volkmar Baur highlights that Japanese inflation fell more than expected in February, with weak services and food prices pointing to ongoing disinflation despite higher Oil.

Commodities.title: Oil: Geopolitics keeps pressure on supply chains – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen notes that Iran’s control over the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing regional tensions are keeping risks elevated for Oil and broader energy markets.
